body.statement: If \(\mathcal C=\varnothing\), \(m=2\), and \(\mathcal T=\{a,b\}\), then \(\Theta(s)\) is the classical binary response-type polytope and the extrema of \(\tau=E[Y_b-Y_a]\) are the Balke--Pearl sharp bounds.
body.justification: The reduction is the required sanity check against the canonical binary instrumental-variable model.
body.gap: This is a known special case and is included as a validation result rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: Implementers can unit-test the reduced incidence matrix against published Balke--Pearl formulas.
